metadata.comparisonRule: Exact canonical JSON comparison. Decode bits, starts, available/padding counts, slots, frame bounds, masks, and source half-pixel interpolation values must match exactly. Each model asset SHA-256 is recorded. expectedPooling is a geometry-only align-corners reference: for j=0..<125 sample input at Double(j)*588/124, compute Float32 linear coefficients, and scatter at integer index j*589/125. This records no Core ML FP16 graph numerical output and is intentionally distinct from WeightInterpolation's 125-point half-pixel result.
metadata.inputConstruction: FluidAudio 0.15.8 at the pinned package revision is used only for the production OfflineSegmentationProcessor, OfflineEmbeddingExtractor, and WeightInterpolation paths. Decoder inputs are deterministic Float32 logits injected into a test-only MLModel subclass; the real segmentation processor performs class selection and postprocessing. Window inputs are deterministic nonzero Float32 samples. Mask inputs use 32001 synthetic audio samples and public SegmentationOutput values with 589 frames and three speaker slots. Each is extracted at supplied chunk offset 2s, the last scheduled start at sample 32000, leaving one real sample and 159999 zero-padded samples in the final window; returned masks remain untrimmed, including the frame-17/frame-18 gate cases. Each stored output is copied from returned TimedEmbedding metadata/masks. Interpolation inputs are deterministic zero, one, ramp, alternating, scattered, and endpoint vectors. Actual Core ML embedding/rho values are deliberately discarded and are not stored. Model loading always uses OfflineDiarizerModels.load from a unique temporary root with a speaker-diarization child, symlinks to validated caller assets, the pinned revision marker, and ModelHub.offlineMode enabled for the load; it removes only that verified staging root. The source model directory remains read-only, and recorded model hashes are computed from the original source assets.
